# KMS Consultants

> KMS Consultants is an immigration consultancy based in Doha, Qatar, with MARA-certified agents for Australian immigration and an IRCC-authorized representative for Canadian immigration. We help individuals, families and professionals living in Qatar and the wider GCC immigrate to Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, the United States and the European Union. The website is available in English (/en) and Arabic (/ar) with full right-to-left support.

KMS Consultants has operated in Doha since 2019 and has handled cases for more than 1,000 clients from over 20 nationalities, earning a 5-star rating on Google. Consultations are confidential and can be requested through the website, by phone or on WhatsApp.

## Credentials

- MARA Certified Agents — registered with the Office of the Migration Agents Registration Authority (Australia).
- IRCC Authorized Representative — authorized to represent clients before Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada.

## Services

- [Skilled Immigration](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/services/skilled-immigration): points-based and employer-sponsored skilled-worker pathways (Express Entry, Australian subclasses 189/190/491, UK Skilled Worker, EU Blue Card).
- [Study Permits](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/services/study-permits): student visas and post-study work routes in Canada, the UK, Australia, the USA and Europe.
- [Work Permits](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/services/work-permits): employer-sponsored temporary and long-term work authorization.
- [Business Residency](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/services/business-residency): investor, entrepreneur and golden-visa residency routes.
- [Permanent Residency](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/services/permanent-residency): permanent residency applications and settlement.
- [Family Sponsorship](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/services/family-sponsorship): spouse, partner, parent and dependent-child sponsorship.
- [Travel Visas](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/services/travel-visas): visitor and tourist visas for the UK, Schengen Area, USA, Canada and Australia for Qatar residents.

## Destinations

- [Canada](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/countries/canada): Express Entry, Provincial Nominee Programs, rural and Francophone community programs, work and study permits, family sponsorship and the Super Visa.
- [United Kingdom](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/countries/united-kingdom): Skilled Worker, Global Talent, High Potential Individual, Student and Graduate Route, family visas, Innovator Founder.
- [Australia](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/countries/australia): skilled migration (189/190/491), Skills in Demand (482) and employer nomination (186), regional 494/191, National Innovation Visa (858), student and graduate visas, partner, parent and child visas.
- [USA](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/countries/usa): H-1B, L-1 and O-1 work visas, EB-1A and EB-2 NIW, EB-5 investor green cards, F-1 and OPT, family and marriage-based green cards.
- [European Union](https://www.kms-consultants.com/en/countries/european-union): EU Blue Card, Germany Opportunity Card, student and post-study permits, family reunification, golden visas and investor residency, digital-nomad visas.
